recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit for FHIR-12288. Do not edit the original Binary XML example for this issue; handle any future DOM-3 or narrative-reference validation change under a separate Jira decision.
issue_request: FHIR-12288 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and asked to fix narrative.html's Image References example because it showed a contained Binary as XML attributes and inline text instead of base64 data in a child element after contentType.
initial_application: The issue was applied by a867ceb8a0eaace039233cefc385a79eb6d4c085 (svn build@11234), which changed the invalid Binary into child elements. The follow-up 5ec6ae5faa21441a3b2a16450cc387e27c54067b corrected Binary.id to a child element, and b96bbd292505dde0f56bdda132c7476d85b19de8 later updated Binary.content to Binary.data.
additional_context: source/narrative.html is in current build scope via source/fhir.ini, source/hierarchy.xml, and publish.ini. FHIR-15896 later clarified the ambiguous image-source sentence from a FHIR-12288 comment, FHIR-22768 documented XHTML references to contained Binary resources, and FHIR-13154 separated Internal Id References from the Image References example. A 2024 Zulip #conformance thread discussed DOM-3 validation of the same corrected example, but that is a separate validation concern rather than a reopened Binary element-shape defect.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/narrative.html already shows the contained Binary as id, contentType, and data child elements, and the old invalid inline Binary form is absent.
